integrity: All proof hypotheses and exceptional cases are stated in RESULT.md; reproducible finite-field matrix checks are included and do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: The graph must be finite connected simple unicyclic. Character degree multiplicities use odd field order. Existing graph-gluing results implicitly compute the marginal rank distribution, so only the finer support-conditioned cancellation law is advanced as the additional result; this is not an independently certified priority determination.
title: Support-conditioned coadjoint rank strata of unicyclic graphical Lie algebras
